title: Network Engineer
description: A roadmap for networking careers: TCP/IP, routing, switching, wireless, firewalls, cloud networking, and troubleshooting.

tree.name: Networking Foundations
tree.description: Learn how devices communicate through OSI/TCP-IP, IP addressing, subnetting, DNS, DHCP, and troubleshooting tools.

resources.title: CCNA Full Course in Hindi (Network Kings)

children.name: IP Addressing and Subnetting
children.description: Calculate subnets, CIDR blocks, gateways, NAT, private ranges, and IPv6 basics.

children.name: Troubleshooting Tools
children.description: Use ping, traceroute, nslookup, dig, netstat, tcpdump, Wireshark, and logs to find faults.

tree.name: Routing and Switching
tree.description: Understand LANs, VLANs, STP, routing tables, static routing, OSPF, BGP basics, and device configuration.

children.name: Switching and VLANs
children.description: Configure access ports, trunks, VLANs, STP concepts, and basic campus network segmentation.

children.name: Routing Protocols
children.description: Learn static routing, OSPF, BGP concepts, route selection, metrics, and path troubleshooting.

children.name: Practice: Packet Capture Investigation
children.description: Use Wireshark to investigate DNS, TCP, TLS, or HTTP failure and write a troubleshooting report.

tree.name: Network Security and Cloud
tree.description: Operate secure networks with firewalls, VPNs, cloud VPCs, load balancers, monitoring, and documentation.

children.name: Firewalls and VPNs
children.description: Understand access rules, stateful firewalls, IDS/IPS basics, site-to-site VPNs, and zero-trust concepts.

children.name: Project: Secure Office Network
children.description: Design a small company network with IP plan, VLANs, routing, firewall rules, Wireshark evidence, and diagrams.

tree.name: Automation and Certification Labs
tree.description: Use scripts, lab simulators, documentation, and certification-style practice to become operationally sharp.

children.name: Network Automation
children.description: Automate inventory, configuration checks, backups, and validation with Python, APIs, Netmiko, or Ansible.

children.name: CCNA-style Lab Portfolio
children.description: Build labs for VLANs, OSPF, NAT, ACLs, DHCP, DNS, VPNs, and troubleshooting evidence.
